title: Production Lite eight-load lifecycle soak

scope.artChange: Extended the reload lifecycle probe to eight loads and repeated it with exposed GC to separate reclaim timing from retained heap.

validation.playwright: Chrome production soak: 8 loads without forced GC and 8 loads with exposed GC

limitations: The non-GC heap rise indicates collection timing; forced-GC samples stabilize near 35.5–36.2 MB but do not prove GPU allocation stability.
This is a single-browser Lite soak, not full device matrix or final performance acceptance; Beta remains open at 12/24 runtime-cleared hero stars and 12/24 rights-cleared nebulae.
